titleEn: I'll Just Go to Bed Today

pages.text: The evening wind was very cold. Green radish leaves stood in the garden. An armful of dry grass lay at its edge.
"I'll pick these radishes in winter." Yuki touched the grass with a fingertip. "I'll just go to bed today."
Yuki slipped under the quilt. "I can cover them tomorrow morning."
That night, everything beyond the window was quiet. Under the porch, Momo tucked front paws beneath their belly.
Morning came. The yard grass was white all over. Yuki ran to the garden.
Radish leaves drooped. They had turned black.
Yuki gently touched a leaf. It crumbled. "They all withered."
Grandma put the dry grass before Yuki. "Only the covered ones survive."
Yuki covered the remaining radishes, pressing the grass down. "Today, I covered them all."
The next morning, the grass covering was white. Lifting it a little revealed green leaves still underneath.
